metadataRaw.title: Inversion Table vs Spinal Decompression Therapy
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over the pros and cons of inversion tables, including specific conditions inversion therapy helps with.

Also, he compares it to non-surgical Spinal Decompression Therapy, and gives you an idea of when to use spinal decompression over an inversion table for neck, lower back, and sciatica pain.
